question: Why must the sacred offering and the vow of non-duality never be disparaged?
premises: The sacred offering must not be reviled.
The non-duality of the vow must also not be reviled.
The instruction is given as a firm prohibition.
inference: One must not disparage the sacred offering or the non-dual vow.
plain_english: O fair one, one should not revile the sacred offering, nor the non-duality of the vow.
